data.value: Multiple database providers are registered ({0}). Use --provider to specify which one to use.
data.comment: Shown when a connection cannot say which provider it meant. {0} is a comma-separated list of provider names. --provider is a command-line option and stays as written.

data.name: Magic_Connect_ProviderMultipleScanned
data.value: Multiple database providers found in loaded assemblies ({0}). Use --provider to specify which one to use.
data.comment: As above, but the providers were found by scanning what is loaded rather than in the registry. {0} is a comma-separated list of type names.

data.name: Magic_Connect_ProviderNoPaths
data.value: (no NuGet assembly paths available; was #r "nuget:" run first?)
data.comment: Goes in as {1} of Magic_Connect_ProviderNotRegistered, saying there was nowhere to look. #r "nuget:" is typed into a cell and stays as written. Keep the brackets.

data.name: Magic_Connect_ProviderNotFound
data.value: No database provider found. Install a provider NuGet package (e.g., Microsoft.Data.Sqlite, Microsoft.Data.SqlClient) and use --provider to specify it.
data.comment: Shown when nothing was registered, guessed, or found. The two package names are examples and stay as written.

data.name: Magic_Connect_ProviderNotRegistered
data.value: Provider '{0}' is not registered. {1} Ensure the provider NuGet package is referenced and DbProviderFactories.RegisterFactory() has been called.
data.comment: Shown when --provider named a provider nothing answers to. {0} is that name. {1} is one of Magic_Connect_ProviderPathsSearched_One, its plural, or Magic_Connect_ProviderNoPaths, and arrives already bracketed. DbProviderFactories.RegisterFactory() is a method name and stays as written.

data.name: Magic_Connect_ProviderPathsSearched_One
data.value: ({0} NuGet assembly path searched)
data.comment: Goes in as {1} of Magic_Connect_ProviderNotRegistered, saying how widely Verso looked. {0} is the count. Keep the brackets.

data.name: Magic_Connect_ProviderPathsSearched_Other
data.value: ({0} NuGet assembly paths searched)
data.comment: Goes in as {1} of Magic_Connect_ProviderNotRegistered, saying how widely Verso looked. {0} is the count. Keep the brackets.

data.name: Magic_Connect_ProviderResolveFailed
data.value: Error resolving provider: {0}
data.comment: A placeholder in the provider name could not be filled in. {0} says why.
